rationale: Replaced twelve generic, dead, misleading, or invalid controls with one literal and recoverable scene-profile axis.; Added six immutable exact-public and ten mutually exclusive generalized semantic profiles.; Implemented an exact input-pure oracle for run-three bands, macro modes, separator cuts, marker balance, original-macro swaps, conditional fill, and paintback.; Added fail-closed linked analysis, output equality, strict self-checking, deterministic fresh returns, global-RNG isolation, unknown-override rejection, and adversarial tests.; Added lawful zero margins to the otherwise collapsing uniform-fill family, raising its output uniqueness to 99.1% without altering the rule branch.; Fixed the executor's empty binding-list serialization and the primitive miner's binding-macro handling, with regression tests; neither canonical source nor canonical grids were rewritten.; Refreshed only the stale derived primitive inventory after the miner fix.
summary: Find maximal row and column bands whose lines contain an exactly-three maximal equal nonzero run, and decode each band intersection by the mode of its nonzero cells. Split the logical board at uniform nonzero non-yellow lines in physical gaps. Within each panel, an all-yellow vertical or horizontal gap strip is a mirror mark: when its sides are balanced, copy paired macro columns or rows across it using values from the original decoded macro board. A marked but unbalanced panel receives no local fill. An unmarked panel replaces macro value 1 with its sole distinct nonzero non-one color when exactly one exists; otherwise it is preserved. Paint the resulting values only into row-band by column-band intersections, leaving all gaps and margins unchanged.
